COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
27.11.2024 FA No. 217 of 2024 
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
The proposed First Appeal has been 
filed against the Award dated 21.09.2024, 
passed by Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation 
and Resettlement Authority / District 
Judge, Pauri Garhwal in LARR No. 1 of 
2023, by which the reference has been 
allowed. 
2. Heard Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, learned 
counsel for the appellant and Mr. J.S. 
Bisht, learned Standing Counsel for the 
respondent no.2. 
3. Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, Advocate, 
submits that the Authority has failed to 
consider the definition of “Affected 
Family”. 
4. Admit. 
5. Notice is issued to the respondent 
no. 1. Steps to be taken within a week. 
6. List on 26.12.2024. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 27.11.2024
Shiv/
